_comment: Gzipped byte budgets for dist/assets/js, enforced by scripts/ci/check-bundle-budget.mjs. eagerJs is what the browser downloads before the entry can run (the entry chunk plus its static import closure). Measured at 431.7 kB on 2026-09-08 and lowered from 454000 to 280000 on 2026-09-09 (US-844), when the Sentry SDK moved behind a dynamic import: 395.6 kB -> 266.6 kB gz, and vendor-sentry left the closure entirely. A budget left above a win is a ceiling, not a ratchet. Measured values and the reasoning are in .ci/bundle-budget.md. Regenerate with --update only for a deliberate, explained change. vendor-supabase was raised from 2932 to 42000 on 2026-09-06: see .ci/bundle-budget.md, the 0.9 kB measurement behind the old number is not reproducible. eagerJs was raised from 280000 to 322000 on 2026-09-10: the 266.6 kB behind the old number was measured on a build with no JWT-shaped VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, which tree-shakes the Supabase client out and shrinks the closure by 39 kB. Every authorized build measures 305.7 kB, so the budget described a bundle that never ships and main ran red for two merges. The check now refuses to generate budgets from such a build and skips the eager comparison on one.
